context: 6 Conclusion Outlook. It remains an open question whether one can obtain good upper bounds for the expected number of steps performed by Random-Edge when the corank is bounded. The only non-trivial result at this point remains the O(log2 n) bound for the case r = 2, which was settled in [6] and which the author has studied further in a more abstract setting in [13]. It might well be that there is a threshold behavior in the sense that Random-Edge performs well for slowly growing r, and badly for quickly growing r. Finally, the same questions can be asked for other simplex pivoting rules that might be easier to analyze. Remark on the dependence on r. The leading factor 1/r!3 in Theorem 18 is rather small.
